# World Battery Hub — Market

> Battery market intelligence — regional market profiles, price trends and forecasts, trade/HS-code references, and industry production/export analysis. Sub-site of the World Battery Hub family.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://market.worldbatteryhub.com/): Entry point to the battery market intelligence site.
- [Battery Market Overview](https://market.worldbatteryhub.com/battery-market-overview/): Global battery market overview.
- [Battery Price Trends](https://market.worldbatteryhub.com/battery-price-trends/): Battery price trend analysis.
- [Battery Price Forecast](https://market.worldbatteryhub.com/battery-price-forecast/): Battery price forecasting.
- [Battery Materials Price Index](https://market.worldbatteryhub.com/battery-materials-price-index/): Raw-materials price index.
- [Battery Demand Forecast](https://market.worldbatteryhub.com/battery-demand-forecast/): Battery demand forecasting.
- [Regional Demand](https://market.worldbatteryhub.com/regional-demand/): Demand by region.
- [China Battery Market](https://market.worldbatteryhub.com/china-battery-market/): China market profile.
- [China Battery Prices](https://market.worldbatteryhub.com/china-battery-prices/): China battery pricing.
- [China Battery Exports](https://market.worldbatteryhub.com/china-battery-exports/): China battery export data.
- [China Battery Production](https://market.worldbatteryhub.com/china-battery-production/): China production analysis.
- [China Lead-Acid Industry](https://market.worldbatteryhub.com/china-lead-acid-industry/): China lead-acid industry profile.
- [China Lithium Industry](https://market.worldbatteryhub.com/china-lithium-industry/): China lithium industry profile.
- [China Battery Clusters](https://market.worldbatteryhub.com/china-battery-clusters/): China battery manufacturing clusters.
- [Lead-Acid Production & Export](https://market.worldbatteryhub.com/lead-acid-production-export/): Global lead-acid production and export.
- [Lead-Acid Battery Market](https://market.worldbatteryhub.com/lead-acid-battery-market/): Lead-acid market segment.
- [Lithium Battery Market](https://market.worldbatteryhub.com/lithium-battery-market/): Lithium market segment.
- [Lithium Price & Supply](https://market.worldbatteryhub.com/lithium-price-supply/): Lithium pricing and supply chain.
- [Sodium-Ion Market Outlook](https://market.worldbatteryhub.com/sodium-ion-market-outlook/): Sodium-ion market outlook.

- [Methodology](https://market.worldbatteryhub.com/methodology/): Market data methodology and caveats.

## Main site

- [World Battery Hub](https://worldbatteryhub.com/): Main knowledge hub (guides, tools, glossary, methodology).

## Notes

- Market data, price figures, and forecasts are estimates/reference figures with estimation uncertainty; see the Methodology page for sources and caveats. Not investment advice.
